grammar_title: 时态(复习 + 过去将来时)Tenses (review + future in the past)
source: 上外版必修第一册 Unit 1 Grammar in Use:时态复习 + 过去将来时。句子地道、学校生活主题,时间状语/语境决定唯一答案,干扰项均为错误时态。

points.point: 一般/进行/完成时态辨析(现在/过去)
points.overview: 看时间状语与语境选时态:now/every day→一般现在;at the moment/now→现在进行;yesterday/last term→一般过去;at this time yesterday→过去进行;already/by now/since→现在完成;by the time + 过去→过去完成。

points.point: 过去将来时 would do / was(were) going to do
points.overview: 站在过去某时点看将来:said/hoped/thought + that 从句用 would do;表过去的打算用 was/were going to do。

points.point: 时态呼应与语境选时态
points.overview: 主从句时态一致(主句过去→从句相应过去/过去将来);by the time / since / when 等连接词决定主从时态搭配。

questions.stem: Every morning before class, Anne ____ her timetable to check which room to go to.
questions.explanation: Every morning 表习惯性动作,用一般现在时。

questions.stem: Look! Jim ____ at a blank sheet of paper and can't think of anything to write.
questions.explanation: Look! 表此刻正在发生,用现在进行时。

questions.stem: Last term our English teacher ____ us a creative writing assignment about summer.
questions.explanation: Last term 是明确的过去时间,用一般过去时。

questions.stem: At this time yesterday evening, I ____ about my new school life in the quiet library.
questions.explanation: At this time yesterday 表过去某刻正在进行,用过去进行时。

questions.stem: It is the first time that I ____ a dorm with three other girls, so everything feels new.
questions.explanation: It is the first time that 后从句用现在完成时。

questions.stem: By the time the teacher arrived, the students ____ their essays into the box.
questions.explanation: By the time + 一般过去,主句动作更早完成,用过去完成时。

questions.stem: These days a lot of new students ____ hard to make friends in our class.
questions.explanation: These days 表现阶段持续动作,用现在进行时。

questions.stem: Many of my classmates ____ good friends of mine since the start of this term.
questions.explanation: since the start of this term 表从过去持续到现在,用现在完成时。

questions.stem: When the bell rang, we ____ a science fiction story aloud in the English class.
questions.explanation: When the bell rang 时另一动作正在进行,用过去进行时。

questions.stem: Jim usually ____ his homework right after dinner, but tonight he can't focus.
questions.explanation: usually 表习惯,用一般现在时。

questions.stem: I ____ already ____ in my assignment when the teacher reminded us of the deadline.
questions.explanation: already + when 过去某点之前已完成,用过去完成时 had handed。

questions.stem: Listen! Someone ____ a welcome speech in the school hall right now.
questions.explanation: Listen! ... right now 表此刻正在进行,用现在进行时。

questions.stem: So far this week I ____ three new friends in my new class.
questions.explanation: So far 表到目前为止,用现在完成时。

questions.stem: Anne ____ home in high spirits on the first day of September last year.
questions.explanation: on the first day ... last year 是过去具体时间,用一般过去时。

questions.stem: Our school library ____ early every weekday so that students can read before class.
questions.explanation: every weekday 表规律性事实,用一般现在时。

questions.stem: While I ____ for the bus this morning, I met an old classmate from junior high.
questions.explanation: this morning 过去某段时间正在进行,While 引导,用过去进行时。

questions.stem: By the end of last term, Jim ____ greater progress in physics than ever before.
questions.explanation: By the end of last term 表过去某点之前完成,用过去完成时。

questions.stem: At present an increasing number of students ____ part in the school drama club.
questions.explanation: At present 表现阶段正在进行,用现在进行时。

questions.stem: The first-year students ____ their way around the building before school started.
questions.explanation: before school started 表过去,用一般过去时。

questions.stem: I ____ this story three times already, and I still find it moving.
questions.explanation: three times already 表到现在的经历次数,用现在完成时。

questions.stem: Before the new term, Anne hoped that she ____ able to join a school drama club.
questions.explanation: hoped 站在过去看将来,从句用过去将来时 would be。

questions.stem: Maybe Jim thought he ____ Mrs Peabody for a chance to rewrite the assignment.
questions.explanation: thought 过去时点看将来的打算,用 would beg。

questions.stem: I was going to ____ you a message last night, but my phone ran out of power.
questions.explanation: was going to + 动词原形 表过去的打算,send。

questions.stem: When she was in junior high, Lin expected that senior high ____ much harder.
questions.explanation: expected (过去) 看将来,用过去将来时 would be。

questions.stem: The teacher said she ____ pass back the writing the following day.
questions.explanation: said + the following day 过去看将来,用 would。

questions.stem: We were going to ____ the new library after class, but it was already closed.
questions.explanation: were going to + 原形,表过去的计划,visit。

questions.stem: Jim promised that he ____ use proper spelling and grammar next time.
questions.explanation: promised 过去看将来,用 would。

questions.stem: Anne believed that she ____ like the school here even before the first lesson.
questions.explanation: believed (过去) 看将来,用过去将来时 would。

questions.stem: Mum knew her daughter ____ meet some unfriendly people in her adult life.
questions.explanation: knew 过去看将来,用 would。

questions.stem: On the first day I felt sure that I ____ make new friends very soon.
questions.explanation: felt sure (过去) 看将来,用 would。

questions.stem: The students were going to ____ their assignments in, but the teacher arrived late.
questions.explanation: were going to + 原形 表过去打算,hand。

questions.stem: Lizzie's father said that growing up ____ help her face difficulties at school.
questions.explanation: said 过去看将来,用 would。

questions.stem: I hoped that my new classmates ____ kind and friendly to me.
questions.explanation: hoped (过去) 看将来状态,用过去将来时 would be。

questions.stem: She told her friend that she ____ join the music club the next month.
questions.explanation: told + the next month 过去看将来,用 would。

questions.stem: We were going to ____ a survey in class, but the lesson ended too soon.
questions.explanation: were going to + 原形 表过去打算,do。

questions.stem: When he started senior high, Tom imagined that everything ____ be perfect.
questions.explanation: imagined (过去) 看将来,用 would。

questions.stem: The new students were told that a training course ____ start before school.
questions.explanation: were told 过去看将来,用 would。

questions.stem: Anne thought the master ____ be able to teach her something useful after all.
questions.explanation: thought (过去) 看将来,用 would。

questions.stem: I was going to ____ part in the interview, but I felt too shy at the last minute.
questions.explanation: was going to + 原形 表过去打算,take。

questions.stem: Mrs Peabody hoped that one student ____ be brave enough to be imaginative.
questions.explanation: hoped (过去) 看将来,用过去将来时 would。

questions.stem: Jim said that he ____ awake until 3 a.m. the night before, worrying about his grade.
questions.explanation: 主句过去 said,从句更早的动作用过去完成时 had stayed。

questions.stem: By the time Anne got to class, the teacher ____ already graded all the essays.
questions.explanation: By the time + 过去,主句更早完成,用过去完成时 had。

questions.stem: Since I joined the drama club, I ____ much more confident in front of others.
questions.explanation: Since + 过去时间点,主句用现在完成时 have felt。

questions.stem: When the teacher walked in, the students ____ quietly about the assignment.
questions.explanation: When + 过去,另一动作正在进行,用过去进行时 were talking。

questions.stem: Mum wrote that she ____ well what it was like to be a teenager.
questions.explanation: 主句过去 wrote,从句陈述当时状态,时态呼应用一般过去 remembered。

questions.stem: Anne announced that she ____ going to like school here.
questions.explanation: 主句过去 announced,从句呼应用 was going to,选 was。

questions.stem: By the end of the third year, Jim ____ great progress and made many friends.
questions.explanation: By the end of ... (过去) 之前完成,用过去完成时 had made。

questions.stem: I didn't know my new desk-mate ____ from the same town as me until we talked.
questions.explanation: 主句过去 didn't know,从句陈述当时事实,时态呼应用一般过去 came。

questions.stem: Since the new term began, our class ____ three interesting school activities.
questions.explanation: Since + 过去,主句用现在完成时 has held。

questions.stem: When Mrs Peabody started to comment on the essays, Jim ____ his eyes nervously.
questions.explanation: When + 过去,主句叙述过去动作,时态呼应用一般过去 closed。

questions.stem: The teacher explained that the library ____ a self-service borrowing system now.
questions.explanation: 主句过去 explained,从句呼应用过去 had。

questions.stem: Before I entered senior high, I had wondered whether I ____ make any friends.
questions.explanation: 主句过去 had wondered,从句站过去看将来,用过去将来时 would。

questions.stem: By the time the bell rang, we ____ the topic sentence for our paragraph.
questions.explanation: By the time + 过去,主句更早完成,用过去完成时 had finished。

questions.stem: She realised that her old fears about senior high ____ unnecessary after all.
questions.explanation: 主句过去 realised,从句指更早的状态,用过去完成时 had been。

questions.stem: Since Lizzie watched the video, she ____ less worried about senior high.
questions.explanation: Since + 过去动作,主句用现在完成时 has felt。

questions.stem: When the new students arrived, some senior students ____ them around the building.
questions.explanation: When + 过去,另一动作正在进行,用过去进行时 were showing。

questions.stem: Marilla said she ____ not tolerate rude words about a teacher.
questions.explanation: 主句过去 said,从句站过去看将来,用 would。

questions.stem: By last Friday our group ____ already chosen its interview topic.
questions.explanation: By last Friday 过去某点之前完成,用过去完成时 had。

questions.stem: I found that the library ____ quiet and comfortable when I first visited it.
questions.explanation: 主句过去 found,从句呼应陈述当时状态,用一般过去 was。

questions.stem: Since we became desk-mates, Zhang and I ____ many things about school together.
questions.explanation: Since + 过去,主句用现在完成时 have shared。
